title: Baked Ziti with Turkey Sausage
description: Ziti pasta baked with turkey sausage, marinara and melted mozzarella.
ingredients: 400 g turkey Italian sausage, casings removed
steps: Cook the pasta until just shy of al dente.
Brown the turkey sausage with onion and garlic, then stir in the marinara.
Combine with the pasta and ricotta, top with mozzarella and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food pasta bake collection

notes: A great freezer meal — assemble and freeze unbaked, then bake from frozen adding 15 extra minutes.
